meta.description: Registry for bounded orientation-sensitive preimage uniqueness behavior across admissibility-preserving reconstruction systems.

preimage_uniqueness_entries.name: Preimage Uniqueness Constraints
preimage_uniqueness_entries.purpose: Represent bounded orientation-sensitive preimage uniqueness behavior across admissibility-preserving reconstruction systems.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_preimage_regions_remain_defined
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Formal support for identifying regions where orientation constraints permit unique preimage recovery.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: multi_valued_reconstruction_remains_preserved
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Reconstruction must not collapse into a single state unless all orientation/admissibility constraints are strictly satisfied.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: reconstruction_updates_remain_admissible
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Every step in the reconstruction sequence must satisfy current process admissibility windows.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: strict_orientation_constraints_do_not_force_global_invertibility
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Localized strict orientation does not imply the global invertibility of the continuation mapping.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: selection_reconstruction_ambiguity_remains_detectable
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to track when selection behavior cannot be uniquely inverted.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: recursive_reconstruction_updates_remain_bounded
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Iterative preimage refinement must stay within established stability thresholds.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_preimage_witness
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Pruning of isolated preimages must not eliminate all possible valid reconstruction paths.

preimage_uniqueness_conditions.name: preimage_uniqueness_instability_remains_detectable
preimage_uniqueness_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to register breakdown in preimage stability or uniqueness.
